# Flessan - thio.cc.cd

> Personal site of M. Thio Saputra ("Flessan"), a self-taught web developer and
> automation engineer from Banjarmasin, South Kalimantan, Indonesia. He builds
> web software, Linux configuration, automation tooling, and runs GDIPS, a
> community-run Geometry Dash private server.

Canonical host: https://thio.cc.cd
Author: M. Thio Saputra (Flessan) - https://thio.cc.cd/about
Languages: English (primary), Indonesian (some posts)
License: MIT for code; posts are (c) M. Thio Saputra unless stated otherwise

## Main pages
- [Home](https://thio.cc.cd/): introduction, search, latest writing
- [About](https://thio.cc.cd/about): who he is, beliefs, toolbox, fun facts
- [Blog](https://thio.cc.cd/blog): every field note, newest first
- [Projects](https://thio.cc.cd/projects): shipped software, forks, experiments
- [Now](https://thio.cc.cd/now): what he is building and learning right now
- [Timeline](https://thio.cc.cd/timeline): dated milestones verified against public records
- [Ecosystem](https://thio.cc.cd/ecosystem): every other place he keeps online
- [GDIPS](https://thio.cc.cd/gdips): the Geometry Dash Indonesia private server
- [Support](https://thio.cc.cd/support): ways to support the open-source work
